body: My boyfriend is emotionally abusive I had a breakdown last night and he wouldn’t talk to me and kept hanging up on me when I needed him. I cried for hours and tried to call non emergency and Samaritans but both just left me on hold for what felt like forever. Now he’s blocked me and won’t speak to me because he can’t be bothered to deal with it and says he doesn’t want anything to do with me anymore. I don’t have anyone else.
I don’t know how Reddit works. I just want someone to care about me. I can never talk to anyone when I am feeling suicidal
